datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2011 across Uganda administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases (IPC scale) aggregated spatially and temporally to produce near-term projections of food insecurity conditions.
